legend: You are given set of n points in 5-dimensional space. The points are labeled from 1 to n. No two points coincide.

We will call point a bad if there are different points b and c, not equal to a, from the given set such that angle between vectors ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bc6e3d5e5515bb66791ca9a052249e959af2a9a6.png) and ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d2b2e44b4b49d4da671b9d05dd70bf58772fc6a6.png) is acute (i.e. strictly less than ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/362ac8c7a7496dffc06cd0c843287cd822be63c3.png)). Otherwise, the point is called good.

The angle between vectors ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f8914399eadbd8be3c3196100658870e03c61fee.png) and ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/453598e99a6c6151192723fb952c1caf35bfa782.png) in 5-dimensional space is defined as ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/73dfa232ec919ce1de408d890c24b9d49969d069.png), where ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/707f1153862986f1b7f8d6ea585c4674982e3bab.png) is the scalar product and ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1ac438acfe8cbf49b733409b450a909ac2b06085.png) is length of ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f8914399eadbd8be3c3196100658870e03c61fee.png).
Given the list of points, print the indices of the good points in ascending order.
input: The first line of input contains a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 103) — the number of points.
The next n lines of input contain five integers ai, bi, ci, di, ei (|ai|, |bi|, |ci|, |di|, |ei| ≤ 103)  — the coordinates of the i-th point. All points are distinct.
output: First, print a single integer k — the number of good points.
Then, print k integers, each on their own line — the indices of the good points in ascending order.
note: In the first sample, the first point forms exactly a ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/362ac8c7a7496dffc06cd0c843287cd822be63c3.png) angle with all other pairs of points, so it is good.

We can see that all angles here are acute, so no points are good.

legend.ai: 给定五维空间中的 n 个点。这些点的编号从 1 到 n。任意两个点都不重合。

如果给定点集中存在两个不同的点 b 和 c，且 b、c 均不等于点 a，使得向量 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bc6e3d5e5515bb66791ca9a052249e959af2a9a6.png) 与 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d2b2e44b4b49d4da671b9d05dd70bf58772fc6a6.png) 之间的角为锐角(即严格小于 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/362ac8c7a7496dffc06cd0c843287cd822be63c3.png))，则称点 a 为坏点。否则，称该点为好点。

在五维空间中，向量 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f8914399eadbd8be3c3196100658870e03c61fee.png) 与 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/453598e99a6c6151192723fb952c1caf35bfa782.png) 之间的角定义为 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/73dfa232ec919ce1de408d890c24b9d49969d069.png)，其中 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/707f1153862986f1b7f8d6ea585c4674982e3bab.png) 表示点积，![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1ac438acfe8cbf49b733409b450a909ac2b06085.png) 表示 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f8914399eadbd8be3c3196100658870e03c61fee.png) 的长度。
给定这些点的列表，请按升序输出所有好点的编号。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 103），表示点的数量。
接下来的 n 行输入包含五个整数 ai、bi、ci、di、ei（|ai|、|bi|、|ci|、|di|、|ei| ≤ 103），表示第 i 个点的坐标。所有点互不相同。

output.ai: 首先，输出一个整数 k，即优良点的数量。
然后，输出 k 个整数，每个整数占一行，即按升序排列的优良点下标。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，第一个点与其他任意一对点恰好形成 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/362ac8c7a7496dffc06cd0c843287cd822be63c3.png) 角，因此它是一个优良点。
在第二个样例中，沿着 cd 平面，我们可以看到这些点如下所示：
可以看到，这里的所有角都是锐角，因此没有优良点。
